## Summary

Follow-up to #1998, ahead of the next release.

#1998 overrides `Symbol.hasInstance` on `http-errors`' `HttpError` with
a duck-type check (`status === statusCode`, boolean `expose`, and so
on), so errors from `http-assert`'s nested `http-errors@1` pass
`instanceof Koa.HttpError`. Because the override *replaces* the
prototype check, a real `HttpError` whose `status` was reassigned after
creation is no longer matched:

```js
const err = new createHttpError.NotFound()
err.status = 418          // statusCode stays 404 (it's on the prototype)
err instanceof HttpError  // 3.2.1: true, master: false
```

The override is installed on the shared `http-errors@2` class, so this
affects every package in the process that uses the same copy, not only
Koa.

## Change

The override now checks the prototype chain first and falls back to
`isHttpErrorLike`. Everything that matched in 3.2.1 still matches, and
the #1998 behavior (duck-typed errors also match) is kept.

## Tests

- New: an `HttpError` with a reassigned `status` is still `instanceof
Koa.HttpError`. This test fails on master and passes with the fix.
- New: a plain `Error` is not matched.
- `npm test` passes 480 of 480 on Node 26, and `npm run lint` is clean.

support for duck-typed HTTP errors.

`Error` instances.
